name: raalarcon-jira-mcp-server
description: Open source MCP Server for Jira & Atlassian — manage issues, sprints, comments, transitions, users, and Confluence pages via Claude, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible AI client. Zero config with npx.

tools.name: get_projects
tools.description: List all Jira projects accessible to the authenticated user

tools.name: get_issue_types
tools.description: Get all available issue types for a specific project

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new Jira issue with full field support and Markdown descriptions

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Get details of a specific issue by key (token-optimized response)

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Update an existing issue's fields

tools.name: delete_issue
tools.description: Delete an issue and optionally its subtasks

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an issue (supports Markdown, auto-converted to ADF)

tools.name: get_comments
tools.description: Get all comments for an issue with pagination

tools.name: update_comment
tools.description: Update an existing comment

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Delete a comment from an issue

tools.name: get_transitions
tools.description: Get available workflow transitions for an issue

tools.name: transition_issue
tools.description: Move an issue to a different workflow state

tools.name: assign_issue
tools.description: Assign an issue to a user

tools.name: get_users
tools.description: Search for users in the Jira instance

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get information about the authenticated user

tools.name: get_agile_boards
tools.description: List all agile boards (scrum and kanban)

tools.name: get_sprints
tools.description: Get all sprints for a board, filterable by state

tools.name: create_sprint
tools.description: Create a new sprint on a board

tools.name: update_sprint
tools.description: Update sprint name, dates, goal, or state

tools.name: close_sprint
tools.description: Close and complete an active sprint

tools.name: delete_sprint
tools.description: Delete a sprint (open issues moved to backlog)

tools.name: move_issue_to_sprint
tools.description: Move an issue into a specific sprint

tools.name: get_sprint_issues
tools.description: Get all issues assigned to a sprint

tools.name: query_wiki
tools.description: Access Confluence pages by URL code with HTML-to-text conversion
